utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Laguna Niguel' by name among the cities in its service area. IMPORTANT CAVEAT confirmed via a separate search this session: Laguna Niguel is split between SCE and San Diego Gas & Electric (SDG&E) territory, with the boundary running along Crown Valley Parkway. This record covers the SCE-served portion of the city only; residents south/east of that boundary may be SDG&E customers instead. Confidence reduced from the usual 0.9 to reflect this genuine split-territory complexity rather than presenting SCE as the sole utility for the entire city.

generation_supplier.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the CCA operating in Orange County, currently names Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley as members — Laguna Niguel was not named among current members this session (only identified as a city that theoretically 'may join'). Left null rather than asserted either way.

county.notes: Laguna Niguel is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.
